 Chicco Nacion • · Sean M. Haffey / Getty Images Sport / Getty Golden State Warriors forward Draymond Green was ejected from Monday's game against the Phoenix Suns after receiving two technical fouls due to a sequence that included him throwing Suns center Khaman Maluach to the floor.
 Green jostled with Phoenix forward Dillon Brooks afterward, leading to the second technical foul.
 Draymond Green was ejected from the game after receiving two technical fouls on this sequence https://t.co/u8IIgeTAGY
— Warriors on NBCS (@NBCSWarriors) November 3, 2026 
 Green appeared to be retaliating after Maluach bowled him over while trying to establish position in the post.
 This is the first time Green has been tossed from a game this season. He was ejected from multiple contests last season.
 The 36-year-old had four points, four boards, two assists, and one steal in 17 minutes before his exit.
 Green, a four-time All-Star, entered Monday's game averaging three points, 5.2 boards, and 7.2 assists through his first five appearances of the campaign.
